title: VXAce I need help with the RE Weapon System II script

posts.author: mrfog
posts.body:
I recently added the RE Weapon System II to my RPG Maker VX Ace project.
I'm new to programming and even new to Ruby.
The system itself is very clean and easy to customize. However, since my project focuses on four characters in the party, I'm experiencing a bug with the weapon sprites.
For example: when I equip a weapon to the party leader, the weapon sprite appears correctly, and that's okay.
But the bug occurs when I change the team's formation. Even though the current leader character isn't equipped with a weapon, the sprite still appears over them.
I'd like some help on how to fix this. Could someone help me?
Thank you in advance.

But the bug occurs when I change the team's formation. Even though the current leader character isn't equipped with a weapon, the sprite still appears over them.
Click to expand...
Short answer, the system is designed as a one player function. That's why it is a resident evil system.
Haven't looked yet, but it may require a lot of work to have it work for multiple actors.
But if you just want the first actor to be the only one to use the weapon then we may just need to figure out how to track the weapon change when the actor swaps positions.
Will look into it when I have time. Hopefully I can figure out what changes need to be made.
